text:
**Best value: ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400W panel kit**—listed at **$698**. It pairs a **1 kWh LiFePO₄ battery** with an **1,800W inverter** and a relatively large 400W panel, making it a strong under-$1,000 option for keeping essentials powered and replenishing the battery in daylight. The listing says it’s a **preorder shipping Dec. 7**, so check the current ship date and price before buying. [See the kit](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit) ([details and listing](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup)).

If you need a kit sooner, the same comparison lists the **BLUETTI AC180 + 200W panel** at **$729**, with availability expected earlier. [See the BLUETTI kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit).

Either is for **essential loads**, not whole-house backup: think phones, lights, router, and limited appliance use—not central air, electric heat, or an oven.
